'''Fenris the Hunter''' was the chieftain of the Thunderlord clan and captain of the remaining Wolfriders in Draenor that Orgrim Doomhammer disbanded soon after the [[First War]].

Shortly after the [[Bleeding Hollow clan]]'s return to Draenor, [[Ner'zhul]] sent [[Dentarg]] to influence warriors from Fenris' clan to join in the battle against the [[Bonechewer clan]], who possessed the [[Skull of Gul'dan]]. The Slayer of the Shadowmoon clan was sent to help rally the Thunderlords and destroy the Bonechewers with the aid of the [[Shattered Hand clan|Shattered Hand]].<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Skull_of_Gul%27dan_(WC2_Orc) The Skull of Gul'dan (WC2 Orc)]</ref> Fenris, who was eager to lead his clan to glorious battle in the human lands, schemed with [[Tagar Spinebreaker]] to journey to Azeroth and have their clans triumph where [[Orgrim Doomhammer]] had failed. This was not a vision that was shared by [[Ner'zhul]], who ordered that their clans be culled as an example to ensure that none would dare to interfere with his dark schemes.<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Thunderlord_and_Bonechewer_(WC2_Orc) Thunderlord and Bonechewer (WC2 Orc)]</ref>

Fenris' subsequent fate is unknown, but his clan survived the destruction wrought upon them and remained part of the Horde of Draenor's forces during the [[Alliance Expedition]]'s later foray into Draenor.<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Once_More_Unto_the_Breach_(WC2_Human) Once More Unto the Breach (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Upon_the_Shadowed_Seas_(WC2_Human) Upon the Shadowed Seas (WC2 Human)]</ref><ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Siege_of_Vanguard_(WC2_Human) Siege of Vanguard (WC2 Human)]</ref>
